notes: The GRU is trained only on Bearing1_1-Bearing1_3 through the training split.
Bearing1_4 is used only for checkpoint selection and Bearing1_5 only for old-holdout evaluation.
Each bearing is centered by its own first 15 embeddings before train-only feature standardization.
The training target is the next standardized centered embedding; normalized lifetime is not used for training.
The GRU Level is the 10-step moving average of hidden-state distance from the first-15 hidden-state mean.
This is a single-seed exploratory experiment on previously inspected bearings, not a blind validation.
